title: Exec readout playbook for runtime performance vs cost tradeoffs
creator: Sasha Nguyen
description: Create a repeatable, slide + one-page playbook and supporting artifact set for executive QBRs and board readouts that clearly communicates the tradeoffs between runtime performance (latency/SLOs) and unit cost (token cost, GPU utilization, batching/quantization). The playbook should include: 1) standard narrative arc for the readout, 2) canonical charts (latency P50/P95, cost per 1M tokens, GPU utilization heatmap), 3) recommended mitigations and tradeoff table, 4) rollout asks with measurable success criteria and 5) a runbook for ad-hoc deep-dive requests from execs.
acceptance_criteria: Single-page executive summary PDF that fits on one slide and reads aloud in 90 seconds
Canonical dashboard links (Console) embedded and a static snapshot for the deck
Tradeoff table with at least three concrete levers (batching, quantization profile, routing policy) and estimated cost/latency delta per lever
Playbook tested in a dry-run with CPO and one engineering lead and updated based on feedback
Actionable rollout asks with owners and measurable KPIs for next quarter
